The '''''Ranger''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighter]] used by the [[Airam Clans|Airam]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces had [[Battle of Swellen|captured]] the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' with the intention of modifying one of their [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] [[Peregrine (Strike-class)|''Peregrine'']] with [[Gravity well projector/Legends|Gravity well projectors]] at the [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] ''[[Gallofree]]''. After successfully doing so, an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force attacked the facility after witnessing the ''Compellor{{'s}}'' destruction. The Alliance sent [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]], along with 3 [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|medium transports]] to evacuate the facility. During the battle the '''Ranger''' joined in to provide support against the Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], some of which were [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]].

After successfully holding of the Imperials. [[Clan leader]] [[Tamaron]] arranged to replenish the Rebels' [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]] at the [[The Drift/Legends|Kuras Drift]]. The '''Ranger''' was also present there when rival Airam forces lead by [[Ilay]] [[Mission to Kuras Drift|attacked]] the Airam base.
